journey.name: Expanded tablet workspace navigation
journey.description: Use the debug-only, non-authenticated fixture to verify PodTrackio's signed-in tablet UI without creating an account or mutating Supabase.

actions.action: Tap the "Preview tablet workspace" debug control
Verify that the Today learning desk is visible with Today, Current streak, and Level metrics
Tap the "Library" navigation item
Verify that library search, category filters, and demo episode rows are visible
Tap the "Build Better Habits with Systems" episode
Verify that the expanded two-pane tablet layout keeps Library visible beside the native player and Summary, Notes, and Quirky inspector tabs
Verify that completion, download, transcript editing, and transcript file import actions remain visible in the split-pane player
Tap the "Notes" inspector tab
Verify that the notes editor and cross-device save explanation are visible
Tap the player close control
Tap the "Progress" navigation item
Verify that lifetime learning, weekly goal, completed metrics, calendar, and schedule management are visible
Swipe upward and verify that achievements remain available below the calendar
Tap the "Settings" navigation item
Verify that the local debug fixture is truthfully labeled, and that all six themes, goals, and adaptive build-up are visible
Swipe upward inside the Settings sheet
Verify that three reminder times, weekdays, quiet hours, adaptive rescue, and the 8 GB download policy are visible
Swipe upward inside the Settings sheet again
Verify that offline quality and encrypted AI connection controls are visible
Swipe upward inside the Settings sheet again
Verify that category management is visible
Verify that the app process remains alive with no PodTrackio fatal exception
